news.title: Dogecoin becomes only losing bet for Japan-listed firm as it sells altcoins for bitcoin

news.title: Bitcoin’s fabled golden cross is coming. And USDT may be the real signal this time

news.title: CFTC asks judge to dismiss CME lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
